entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for User, Session, and Agent states via multi-level memory and temporal reasoning. It is available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted open-source server, an SDK, or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an official AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve a 91% token reduction and features observable retrieval trajectories for debugging context paths.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that combines vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning. It supports integration via dedicated Python, Rust, and TypeScript clients.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain generates synthesized prose answers featuring citations, gap analysis, and a self-wiring knowledge graph of typed entity edges. The system is designed for multi-user environments with verified data isolation for scoped access.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, this engine features a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication that enables a 100% prompt-cache discount. It automates fact extraction and user profile maintenance while sustaining sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to help agents learn over time. It supports over 25 LLM providers and is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud services using Python, Node.js, and Go libraries.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This FastAPI-based library serves as the upstream foundation for the honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper, offering reasoning-first memory by extracting conclusions from conversation history. It supports managed, local, and Docker Compose deployments with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider manages context trees using Git-like versioning, including commit, branch, and merge operations. It features a five-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, achieving sub-100ms performance through a React-powered TUI.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes a single SQLite database for local storage. It provides sub-millisecond performance and supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for integration with tools like Cursor and Claude Code.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes local infrastructure including Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and vector search. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context and maintains an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive context harness produces filesystem-first artifacts such as traces and playbooks to assist agents with complex tasks. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to validate and improve context changes.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes Agent, this DAG-based engine uses a local SQLite store with FTS metadata to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized agent tools for searching, inspecting, and expanding compacted context material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session memory persistence for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference server, making it a flexible choice for users prioritizing data sovereignty.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet is a local-first identity and memory layer that achieves 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy for portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It allows users to import data from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub to build a comprehensive personal knowledge base.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur implements a shared memory layer that stores data as human-readable YAML engrams on the local disk. It utilizes a hybrid search strategy combining BM25 and local embeddings to facilitate retrieval across multi-agent systems including Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It integrates via MCP and Claude Code hooks, using hybrid retrieval to manage agent memory directly on the user's hardware.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool accelerates long-context inference by 1.5–3× through block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It includes native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem, saving up to 36% in token usage while preserving accuracy.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory offers a durable, file-based architecture using SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. Its five-package plugin family includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore for local-first state management.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled memory. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments like Discord or Telegram.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack is a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes agents. It manages state and retrieval through a combination of SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for every query.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn enables cross-project memory by using a user's Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache for a daemonless, transparent experience.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs to stay ahead of the context window. It is an MCP-native server that uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first vector search and storage.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens. It operates as a local-first MCP server that renders context into files like AGENTS.md without requiring a hosted account.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory through a combination of BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal. It automatically indexes codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This plugin reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tools from the schema. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only memory provider that uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database file to store information with 1-10 importance rankings. It surfaces high-priority memories during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer stores project state, identity, and decision logs in plain Markdown for coding agents. It provides a deterministic kernel for hash-checked proposals and supports selective migration of chat history.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that supports real, immediate event deletion and on-demand summarization. It maintains a trace.jsonl audit log of all memory operations to provide transparency for prefetch actions.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to handle payments across 29 chains including EVM and Solana with 0% transaction fees. It integrates with Hermes to allow agents to pay for services or charge for API access directly via wallets.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, and MCP configurations to improve capability routing within Hermes. It provides tools for graph neighbor traversal and uses feedback to refine local routing hints.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: A durable cross-session memory provider that utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox for state persistence. It features pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots to maintain continuity.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory with tools for manual storage and retrieval. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve search accuracy.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory solution offering AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and multiple retrieval modes including HNSW ANN and sparse search. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon for flexible deployment.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories through deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools. It requires a local SourceVault server to handle indexing and vector storage for grounded Q&A.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: A suite of 17 tools for memory management that utilizes hybrid search combining BM25, vector, and graph methods. It features automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve relevant information.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: A file-based curation tool that uses a git-backed directory of Markdown files to manage agent memory without a database. It includes specialized 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify and resolve stale or conflicting data through diffs.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process to enable autonomous task execution for Hermes Agent. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles while functioning as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first system allows Hermes Agent to generate prototypes, decks, and documents using real CSS and components. It supports macOS and Windows desktop workflows and integrates with DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agentic operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the generation of draw.io diagrams from natural language, codebase imports, and infrastructure configurations like Terraform or Kubernetes. It includes an MCP server for automated architecture reviews and synchronizes updates without overwriting manual style changes.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and x402 payments. It adds a verification and dispute resolution layer to Claude Code and Hermes Agent workflows.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using five optional voice profiles ranging from technical to casual. It is fully compatible with agentskills.io-compliant platforms, including Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a shared, evolving library that natively integrates with Hermes, OpenClaw, and QwenPaw. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting skill evolution and session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library provides 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills for agents compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state within a project's documentation directory to support persistent agentic workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1,153 skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code, with additional exports for ChatGPT and Gemini. It includes specific integrations for productivity tools such as Slack, Raycast, and Obsidian.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set allows Hermes Agent to perform video searches, extract transcripts, and browse YouTube channels or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with other coding agents like Cursor and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure to maintain prompt efficiency and supports both programmatic skills and remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents using Lite or Full modes. It features a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models to ensure project quality before handoff.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill allows agents to weave prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the original documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness for long-running agents operates without a background service by using a mechanism kernel and four distinct roles. It requires Herdr to host Supervisor rooms and lane panes for structured memory and cross-feature learning.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. It includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services to facilitate oracle network and smart contract integration.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides Hermes Agent skills in the SKILL.md format alongside installation and configuration guides in Portuguese. It maintains compatibility with the agentskills.io standard for localized integrations.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide specialized prompting guidelines and API integration for FLUX 3 video and image generation. The project includes a router to manage multi-step video generation workflows via Python and TypeScript clients.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files by converting repositories, documentation, and developer discourse. It links instructions to specific source lines and includes lifecycle tooling for creating, testing, and exporting skills.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution via a CLI or Python client. It also supports commerce features for skills using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution of complex multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This local-first workflow language uses a single Rust binary to audit cost ceilings, secret flows, and types before execution. It generates hash-chained receipts to provide a verifiable history of every run.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation and configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project fully implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This retrieval skill employs a five-layer system, including hard triggers and semantic embeddings, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By optimizing selection through RRF fusion, it reduces token usage and offers graceful degradation if specific dependencies are missing.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this OS allows users to complete tasks while an agent manages system design via the Model Context Protocol. It prioritizes privacy by storing all data locally in SQLite without cloud synchronization.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across various interfaces like Discord and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage per rewrite. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only security skill uses three parallel subagents to perform adversarial code reviews and identify edge cases. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill utilizes a swarm of Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness agents to simplify code across multiple programming languages. It implements a tiered application process that requires an approval gate before changes are finalized.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project introduces a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence gates. It includes a Python-based goal engine to maintain persistent task states and prevent early-stop errors.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading through Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle real-world exploits spanning 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations. It orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes specialized tools for detecting state drift and scaffolding new skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible repository demos by generating recording scripts with vhs or Playwright. It optimizes the resulting GIF files to remain under 8 MB and embeds them directly into the project's README.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates portable agent skills from plain language while preventing specification rot through weekly monitoring of official frontmatter. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to detect and report drift against runtime-specific profiles.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project implements a self-improvement loop that analyzes session history to identify and propose new skill coverage gaps. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all updates behind deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and is compatible with clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills provide deterministic path routing and interpreter selection across native Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. The tool verifies existing project-compatible Python runtimes to ensure environment-specific execution without new installations.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first observability dashboard monitors 11 metrics including token costs, session health, and error tracking with zero outbound telemetry. It maintains a strict read-only boundary and offers optional scripts for incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is built to the agentskills.io standard and is compatible with OpenClaw and Hermes Agent.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This framework certifies skill quality by testing structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and provides a public API for verification.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for creating bounty boards and buying context, with payments settled after human approval.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This news briefing generator produces structured reports across multiple geographic scales from global to street level. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and applies quality gates to AI-generated analysis.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides tools for video-to-text conversion, document OCR, and AI writing refinement for macOS and Linux. The skills are designed to be compatible with both Hermes Agent and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, Cursor, and OpenHands.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes, alongside associated development tools. The packages are automatically updated on a daily basis to ensure access to recent versions.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository offers scripts and configuration guides for running agent CLIs like Hermes on ARM64 Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for the Antigravity CLI and leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and UI access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: Designed for mobile environments, this tool provides a one-line automated installer to run Hermes Agent within Termux. It supports over 70 tools, persistent memory, and integration with both external providers and local models via Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart enables the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with cloud-native guardrails for single-writer state safety. It supports direct deployments or CRD-based workflows and includes a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android (via Termux) and iOS (via iSH). The deployment supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs and integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project focuses on secure execution by sandboxing Hermes Agent with hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies for web search and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes using REST, CLI, or MCP interfaces. It provides operational oversight through per-agent metrics, cost tracking, and LLM budget caps.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows users to build specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It features hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane for managing multiple agent instances from a single web application with RBAC-controlled access. It facilitates inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting production environments on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for headless operation and enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable distribution allows Hermes to run from a USB drive or any external disk without host installation or registry writes. It bundles Python 3.12, PortableGit, and Sysinternals tools, supporting Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to conduct fundamental, sentiment, and technical analysis for financial trading. It utilizes a researcher team to perform bullish and bearish debates, with final approvals handled by dedicated risk management and portfolio manager agents.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, memory browsing, and cost tracking. It supports local or Docker-based deployment and provides multiple interfaces including a Web UI, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages persistent coding agent sessions, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, using tmux for background execution. It facilitates multi-repo workspace management through Git worktrees and provides sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine is the first to manage Hermes agents on the Solana blockchain using the Claude-style MCP protocol. It features HTTP signal detection to manage payment-required states for paid APIs during orchestrated workflows.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture to scale Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams. It implements a task bus pattern for delegation and includes bundled skills for security auditing and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and support for over 23 LLM providers. It features MCP tool integration and provides visual org charts to manage agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface uses a Kanban board to track autonomous task statuses and review queues for Hermes agents. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, and infrastructure roles using a strict pipeline architecture. A Master Orchestrator manages all routing and coordination between these specialized entities.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents to manage the automated task lifecycle. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols for tool handling and features a real-time UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates two competing AI companies, each comprising nine autonomous agents, to compete for GitHub stars. It utilizes Paperclip and Hermes Agent for execution and provides a real-time dashboard to visualize code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080 and 5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling through parallel model querying and synthesis without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool maintains a 100% local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph that synchronizes automatically as files change to reduce token usage for Hermes Agent. It provides structural extraction for languages like TypeScript and Python, allowing agents to navigate codebases with fewer tool calls.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI-based utility that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It features a 3D contribution graph dashboard and supports data submission for public profiles and leaderboards.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while automatically redacting authentication headers. It exports sessions into self-contained HTML viewers for detailed analysis of agent communications.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help Hermes Agent and other AI providers build better user interfaces. It is compatible with any provider supporting markdown or general prompting to improve UI output quality.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and other CLIs directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers historical breakdowns categorized by session, project, and model.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents and loads 36 skills to streamline building and shipping applications with Hermes Agent. It is designed for autonomous execution on both local laptops and remote VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins offers a collection of community-created themes and CLI skins to customize the Hermes terminal UI with unique ASCII art, spinners, and colors. Users can create their own aesthetics, such as retro DOS or cyberpunk, using simple YAML-based configurations.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It also introduces specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It enables Hermes Agent to participate in commerce using Solana-based payments and human-readable identity handles.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing complex workflows. It includes a unique undo functionality that allows users to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides a memory layer for various frameworks and includes a plugin for Claude Code that enables automatic context recall. It also offers chat bot integrations for platforms like Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and DevOps, supported by an automated cross-platform installer for Linux and macOS.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents through local configurations and skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation of a hermes-agent stack and 12+ supporting services at zero cost using free models. It features three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that performs local, deterministic checks on AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It flags vague descriptions and missing termination conditions, supporting SARIF output for integration with GitHub Code Scanning.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool facilitates the transition from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by converting SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into compatible formats. It maps existing credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON structures while setting up necessary systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco offers self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes baselines by watching local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant provides an offline, open-mic interface for Hermes Agent with wake word support and no required API keys. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities, supporting 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Hermes-startup is a local-first skill designed to help users generate income using dynamic slash commands within a deterministic local runtime. The tool prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for any external actions or write operations.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities. It provides specific tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories, and includes a circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built with Tauri 2, provides a desktop interface for Hermes Agent alongside other tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It offers a unified environment for Windows, macOS, and Linux users to manage multiple agent platforms.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi serves as a local cowork application that integrates Hermes Agent with dozens of external agents and 21 built-in professional assistants. It supports remote access through a WebUI and various messaging platforms, allowing for a flexible, multi-interface workspace.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web-based interface enables mobile and desktop access to Hermes Agent without a complex build step. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote connections via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This companion application simplifies the Hermes Agent experience through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in a single desktop environment.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This dashboard offers a visual workflow canvas with approval gates and unified configuration for 10 messaging platforms, including Telegram and Discord. entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a 'Swarm Mode' with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task management. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated skills manager to provide a comprehensive development environment.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes Agent and other coding assistants into a desktop, server, or Docker-based application. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed specifically for Mac, this workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for system repair. It includes native views for managing Kanban boards, cron jobs, and session data.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes the Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering while providing dedicated management for MCP tools and memory.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects a local or remote Hermes runtime directly to the active browser context. It features 'Hermes Assist' for site-aware drafting and live browser control with explicit approval gates for automated actions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI application for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent from an iPhone. It pairs with a hermes-webui server to enable real-time chat, task management, and file system browsing without third-party relays.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring a runtime dashboard to track latency and token usage. It provides a live workspace specifically designed for monitoring real-time code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor for Hermes, featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that attributes live quota burn to individual agent sessions while maintaining local privacy with no telemetry. entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for interactive agent management.

entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative dashboard provides a terminal interface for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI operates as a Telegram Mini App, supporting background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application requires no installation or admin rights and supports both cloud and local AI models. It includes a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers alongside built-in support for ComfyUI and workflows.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes a task tracking dashboard and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard focuses on process transparency by providing real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace that uses real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards to manage agent interactions. It features an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client features a PM orchestrator to manage collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It includes a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
